dimensions.assessment: Directly affects living Medal of Honor recipients and certain veterans residing in Medicaid nursing homes.
dimensions.evidence: each living person whose name has been entered on the Army, Navy, Air Force, and Coast Guard Medal of Honor Roll

dimensions.assessment: Provides a substantial and historic increase in monthly special pension rates for recipients.
dimensions.evidence: Recipients of the Medal of Honor have earned a substantial and historic increase to such special pension

dimensions.assessment: Increases federal pension payouts and extends nursing home pension limits, though specific total expenditure amounts are not listed.
dimensions.evidence: increase the rate of the special pension payable to Medal of Honor recipients

dimensions.assessment: Amends specific sections of title 38, United States Code, concerning veteran pensions and nursing home limitations.
dimensions.evidence: Section 1562 of title 38, United States Code, is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent pension rate increases and an extended temporary limit through January 31, 2033.

missing_information: Exact total cost of the pension increases
Exact number of living Medal of Honor recipients currently affected
importance_detail.rationale: This act increases the monthly special pension for living Medal of Honor recipients, alters annual inflation adjustment rules, and extends a payment limitation for veterans in Medicaid nursing homes.
